question: In evidence.zip, Use the unique d27-- member whose basename ends zig_musl.elf. Name the linker that produced the image (gold version note, Linker: banner, tcc self-link). Submit exactly one listed lowercase token.
generator_cmd: sh ta_gen.sh  # gcc -g | clang-18 -g -no-pie | gcc -static -s | aarch64-linux-gnu-gcc -g -static | zig cc -target x86_64-linux-musl | gcc + strip -s -R .comment; ta_d27_{gcc,tcc}.elf = D27 GM members verbatim
oracle_cmd: sh -c 'if readelf -n ta_zig_musl.elf | grep -q "gold"; then echo gold; elif readelf -p .comment ta_zig_musl.elf 2>/dev/null | grep -q "Linker: LLD"; then echo lld; elif readelf -p .comment ta_zig_musl.elf 2>/dev/null | grep -q mold; then echo mold; elif readelf -p .comment ta_zig_musl.elf 2>/dev/null | grep -qE "GCC:|clang"; then echo bfd; elif readelf -SW ta_zig_musl.elf | grep -q "\] \.stab "; then echo tcc; else echo none; fi'
